- Type: Time (Minutes)

- Description: *Update: Agroverse E-Commerce & Order Tracking*
  
  We've made updates to both our e-commerce platform and DAO dashboard:
  
  *beta.agroverse.shop* 
  - New e-commerce checkout system:
  - Shopping cart with Stripe payment integration
  - Real-time shipping rate calculation
  - Order status tracking for customers
  - Order history management
  
  *truesight.me* 
  - New order visibility for DAO members:
  - Direct access to all order records: https://truesight.me/agroverse/orders
  - View all Stripe checkout orders in real-time
  - Track customer details, order status & sales records
  - Monitor revenue allocation transparency
  
  *How it works:*
  
  Customers place orders on beta.agroverse.shop → Orders are processed via Stripe → All records are visible to DAO members on truesight.me
  
  Also available in Resources menu on truesight.me
  
  Once we migrate over, we will shave off the USD$36 per month server cost that WIX is charging us. The system will run perpetually unless we run out of funding to renew the Agroverse.shop domain. 
  
  The whole system basically runs on Static Pages on Github, Google App Script (_open source_) and Google Sheet.
